title: Host-judged Activities
description: The host runs the activity and enters the final standings by hand.
attribution: Written for Mshikaki by the Innovations team

items.prompt: Charades: Kenyan places. Act one out, the room guesses.
Two truths and a lie. The room votes on the lie.
Story chain: each person adds one sentence to a story about the team.
60-second pitch: sell an everyday object as if it were new technology.
Human knot: everyone holds hands across the circle and untangles without letting go.
Sound effects only: hum a Kenyan advert and let the room guess it.
Draw and guess: sketch a Kenyan landmark in 30 seconds.
Team quiz relay: one person per question, rotate every round.
Explain it badly: describe your job using only five words.
Memory tray: reveal ten objects for 20 seconds, then recall them.
Standing debate: argue for or against pineapple on pizza, 30 seconds each.
Silent lineup: order yourselves by height, birthday or distance travelled, without speaking.
